title: Canon PIXMA G3010
greeting: Hi, this is Mistri. What are we fixing today?
greeting_returning: Hi again. What's the printer doing?
handoff: I can't pin this down over the phone. Let's get a technician to look at it.
after_end: We're done here. You can hang up whenever you like.
hints: Canon, PIXMA, G3010, A4, LTR, letter, 4 by 6, four by six, photo paper, orange light, warning light, page icon, OK button, Wi-Fi

faults.name: Paper size mismatch
faults.explain: The printer's set for {size_desc}, but there's {paper_desc} in it, so it stopped.

steps.say: Press the button with the page picture until {paper} lights up, then press OK.
steps.help: It's the top button next to the size lights, with a little page on it. OK is the one under it.

faults.rule: orange light, check the size light matches your paper.

faults.name: Out of paper

steps.say: Put a small stack of A4 in the back tray, print side up, slide the guide against it, then press OK.
steps.help: The tray is at the back, under the flap on top. Lift the flap and the slot is right there.

faults.rule: orange light, check there's paper in the back tray.

faults.name: Paper jam

steps.say: Hold the stuck sheet with both hands and pull it out slowly, straight towards you.
steps.help: Both hands on the sheet, and pull slowly so it doesn't tear.

steps.say: Now close the cover and press OK.
steps.help: OK is the round button next to the lights.

faults.rule: orange light, open the front cover and look for a stuck sheet. Pull it out slowly.

faults.name: Ink empty
faults.explain: One of the inks has run out.

steps.say: Open the ink cover and top up the tank under the blinking light, then close it.
steps.help: The ink cover is the front panel. The tank to fill sits under the light that's blinking.

faults.rule: blinking ink light, top up the tank under it.

faults.name: Cover open
faults.explain: The top cover isn't fully closed.

steps.say: Push the top cover down firmly until it clicks.
steps.help: The top cover is the lid over the paper output. Press the middle of it.

faults.rule: orange light, push the top cover down until it clicks.

faults.name: Not connected
faults.explain: The printer isn't on the Wi-Fi, so the job never reaches it.

steps.say: Hold the Wi-Fi button for three seconds, until the blue light blinks.
steps.help: The Wi-Fi button has the little wave symbol, next to the power button.

steps.say: Now press the WPS button on your router.
steps.help: It's usually a small button on the back of the router marked WPS.

faults.rule: Wi-Fi light off, reconnect it with the Wi-Fi button and WPS.

tests.label: Warning light?
tests.ask: Is there a warning light on? What colour is it?

answers.label: Orange light
answers.note: Orange light is likely under 5 of 6 causes; Wi-Fi trouble shows a different light

tests.label: Size light?
tests.why_first: On the G3010 the size lights sit next to the warning light, one glance away: ask that first
tests.ask: Look next to that orange light. There's a little column: A4, LTR, 4 by 6. Which one's lit?

answers.label: LTR
answers.note: Most people leave it on A4, so LTR points at a size mismatch

answers.ack: That's 4 by 6, the small photo size.
answers.note: Most people leave it on A4, so 4 by 6 points at a size mismatch

tests.label: Paper type?
tests.ask: What paper did you put in: normal sheets, or small photo paper?

tests.label: Paper stuck?
tests.ask: Open the front cover. Can you see any paper stuck inside?

tests.label: Ink level?
tests.ask: Is the ink light, the one with the drop symbol, on or blinking?

tests.label: Cover closed?
tests.ask: Is the top cover fully closed?

tests.label: Wi-Fi light?
tests.ask: Is the blue Wi-Fi light on?
